_comment: The dashboard's seven simulation presets (frontend/dashboard/src/App.tsx). The agents receive pricing_group, objectives and constraints, exactly as POST /pricing-cycles sends them; title and context are for the report only.

requests.title: Supply Chain Disruption
requests.context: Rising costs from supply chain issues; protect margins while staying competitive.

requests.title: Viral Demand Spike
requests.context: A product goes viral; balance revenue against stock depletion.

requests.title: Competitor Price War
requests.context: A competitor cuts prices 15%; respond with competitive positioning.

requests.title: Seasonal Trend Shift
requests.context: End of season; clearance pricing while protecting brand value.

requests.title: High Stock Clearance
requests.context: Excess inventory; find the markdown depth that moves units fast.

requests.title: Premium Positioning
requests.context: Luxury segment; keep a premium perception while maximizing margin.

requests.title: Low Inventory Alert
requests.context: Stock running low on a popular item; raise prices to slow demand.
